stories.title: Fan 'Storms Out' as Team Loses on TV, Only to Become Hero for Woman Stuck in Mud Chest-high
stories.label: people
stories.summary: A man named Alastair stepped outside in frustration after watching his favorite football team lose badly on TV. While cooling off outdoors, he heard cries for help and found a woman trapped chest-high in thick mud, unable to free herself. He acted fast and managed to pull her to safety before the situation turned dangerous. What started as a disappointing evening turned into the night he saved someone's life. It's a sweet reminder that help can show up in the most unexpected moments.
stories.why_good: A real rescue where quick action by an ordinary person saved someone from real danger, with a happy ending and no political angle.

stories.title: Rare 1-in-100M 'Ghost' Lobster Finds a New Home at University Marine Center
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: A strikingly pale 'ghost' lobster, the kind of find that only turns up about once in a hundred million catches, has a new home just in time for Halloween. Instead of ending up on a dinner plate, it was donated to the University of New England's Marine Science Center in Maine. Scientists there get the rare chance to study what makes its coloring so unusual, which could teach us more about lobster genetics. It's a happy ending for a one-of-a-kind creature, and a neat opportunity for researchers and visitors alike.
stories.why_good: A real, already-completed event where a rare animal was saved from being eaten and given to science and the public to enjoy and learn from.
